scope: S label audit only; no model training/promotion; no biological validation claim

source_S_definition.tie_convention: stable sort (equal raw values ordered by gene_id), NOT average-rank

affine_transform.endpoint_tolerance_note: canonical Score_S stored to 6 decimals; stored min defined = 0.678811 vs exact a = 0.67881058538322

S_defined_rank.formula: average-rank ties on full-precision S_raw among M defined genes; quantile=(rank-1)/(M-1)
S_defined_rank.ties: explicit average-rank (differs from legacy stable gene_id-order tie-break)
S_defined_rank.degenerate_note: M<=1 unsupported (division by zero); here M=18947>1

pipeline_counts.gene_split_manifest_note: separate 56161-gene reference manifest (symbol-annotated); not the v6-input record universe

es_sensitivity.note: S rescaling changes E*S objective weighting; NOT biological validation
